authors.bio: WangNan is a software architect and founder. He maintains PLAY HYPE GAMES, writes its game notes and checks the catalogue's embeds and metadata; he is not a game developer.
longBio: WangNan is a software architect and founder. He maintains PLAY HYPE GAMES, writes its game notes, and checks the catalogue's embeds and metadata before a page is treated as reviewed.

He founded Uncorne, a senior-led studio building AI SaaS, LLM and RAG systems, React Native apps and the cloud architecture underneath them. His writing on make1day.dev is built against working code, and the same rule applies here: label what was checked, and say what was not.
